faq.howDoIChoose: How do I choose the right race category?
faq.considerYourFitnessLevel: Consider your fitness level, running experience, and goals. If you're new to running, the 5K Fun Run is a great starting point. For experienced runners, the Half or Full Marathon offers a greater challenge. The 10K is a good middle ground for those with some running experience.
faq.canISwitchMy: Can I switch my race category after registration?
faq.yesYouCanSwitch: Yes, you can switch your race category up to 14 days before the event. Please contact our support team to make the change. Additional fees may apply if switching to a higher-priced category.
faq.areThereAgeRestrictions: Are there age restrictions for the different categories?
faq.yesTheFullMarathon: Yes, the Full Marathon is open to participants 18 years and older, the Half Marathon for 16+, and the 10K for 14+. The 5K Fun Run is open to all ages, though children under 12 must be accompanied by a registered adult participant.
faq.whatIsIncludedIn: What is included in my race registration?
faq.allRegistrationsIncludeA: All registrations include a race bib with timing chip, finisher medal, event t-shirt, access to water stations and medical support during the race, and entry to the post-race celebration. Full and Half Marathon participants also receive a gear check service.
faq.isThereATime: Is there a time limit to complete the races?
faq.yesTheFullMarathon2: Yes, the Full Marathon has a 6-hour time limit, the Half Marathon has a 4-hour limit, the 10K has a 2-hour limit, and the 5K has a 1.5-hour limit. These limits ensure the safety of all participants and allow for timely reopening of roads.
